privacy.title: How we handle your data
privacy.intro: We built this platform to connect you with the recruiters at the Pristini JE job fair. We handle your personal information (your name, phone number, email and career history), so here is exactly what happens when you upload your CV.

sections.title: 1. How your CV is read (AI extraction)
sections.text: Instead of making you fill in long forms, we send your CV to an AI service, Google Gemini, which reads it and fills in your profile. We use Gemini's free tier, so Google may use your CV to train and improve its AI models.

sections.title: 2. Your CV file is not kept
sections.text: The file you upload is deleted as soon as the AI has read it, or if reading fails. Only the profile built from it is kept. When a recruiter downloads your CV, they get a PDF made from your profile, never your original file.

sections.title: 3. Who can see your profile
sections.text: Nobody sees anything before you check and approve your profile. Once you approve it, every company registered for the fair can see your full profile, including your phone number and email, so they can contact you for interviews. Besides those companies, the only service that receives your CV is Google Gemini, which reads it. We never sell your data.

sections.title: 4. How long it is kept, and how to delete it
sections.text: Your profile is kept for this job fair. You can delete your profile and your account at any time from "My profile".

contact.title: 5. Your rights and who to contact
contact.text: Under the Tunisian personal data protection law (Organic Law No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004), you can access, correct or delete your personal information at any time. Questions? Write to the Pristini Junior Entreprise team at {email}.
